entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Armorer of Tetsuo Umezawa and teacher of Kei Takahashi, who knew blue and white magic and could destroy artifacts and enchantments by will.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Imperial champion of Madara whom Ayesha served as armorer.

entities.name: Kei Takahashi
entities.description: Ayesha's apprentice, infected with Xira's brood and later murdered by Halfdane.

entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: Insect who infected Kei with her brood.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Lord whose attack on the Edemi Islands failed; master of Halfdane.

entities.name: Marhault Elsdragon
entities.description: General commanding the kentsu who ordered Ayesha to Argenti.

entities.name: Tor Wauki
entities.description: Tetsuo's second, who was with Kei in his final fight and helped kill Halfdane.

entities.name: kentsu
entities.description: Brutal soldiers who attacked the islands under General Elsdragon.

entities.name: Jorgan Hage
entities.description: Leader under whom Ayesha served on Kusho.

entities.name: Gosta Dirk
entities.description: Island defender who wanted a formal duel to decide Kusho's fate.

entities.name: Ramirez DePietro
entities.description: Shapeshifter minion of Ramses Overdark, disguised as Ramirez, who poisoned Kusho's mana lines and murdered Kei.

entities.name: Lord Magnus
entities.description: Avatar of the forest and the Sylvan Library who gave Ayesha a cure.

entities.name: Sylvan Library
entities.description: Forest library on Argenti attacked by Ayesha's soldiers.

entities.name: Kusho
entities.description: Island with blue mana lines, poisoned by black mana crystals.

entities.name: Argenti
entities.description: Island where the Sylvan Library stands.

entities.name: Edemi Islands
entities.description: Islands attacked by Overdark and later by the kentsu.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War during which Xira infected Kei.

entities.name: Wasitora
entities.description: Creature whose kittens retrieved Ayesha and Tor.

events.summary: Ayesha takes Kei Takahashi in as apprentice from his abusive foster family.
events.quote: she took on Kei Takahashi , whom she had taken from his abusive foster family

events.summary: Ayesha and Tetsuo stop Xira's spawn from growing, but Kei keeps the insectoid mutations.
events.quote: Ayesha and Tetsuo managed to stop Xira's spawn from growing any further

events.summary: Bolas punishes Tetsuo, who must accompany the kentsu; Ayesha, Kei and Tor are put under kentsu control.
events.quote: Ayesha, Kei, and Tetsuo's second, Tor Wauki , were also put under kentsu control.

events.summary: Ayesha is kidnapped by Kusho's defenders, then escapes with Ramirez DePietro's help.
events.quote: She escaped from the rebels with the help of Ramirez DePietro

events.summary: Ayesha falls ill from black mana crystals poisoning Kusho's mana lines, the work of Halfdane in disguise.
events.quote: Ramirez was the shapeshifter Halfdane , a minion of Ramses Overdark, in disguise.

events.summary: Ordered to Argenti, Ayesha leads an attack on the Sylvan Library, secretly seeking cures for her addiction and Kei's mutations.
events.quote: There she led a group of soldiers to attack the Sylvan Library .

events.summary: Ayesha becomes the Library's avatar and, with the forest, defeats the kentsu on Argenti and Kusho.
events.quote: She fought against the kentsu, and her cunning was just what the forest needed to get an edge over them.

events.summary: Magnus resumes his role and gives Ayesha a cure; Kei is found murdered by Halfdane.
Ayesha freezes the water around Halfdane and Tor kills him with a black spell.
events.quote: Ayesha managed to freeze the water around him

events.summary: Ayesha and Tor reunite with Tetsuo and persuade him to become imperial champion again.
events.quote: they convinced him to take up the role of imperial champion once more

relations.quote: Ayesha Tanaka was the armorer of Tetsuo Umezawa

relations.note: killed him with a black spell
relations.quote: which gave Tor the time he needed to kill it with a black spell
